findings.title: Usage-error message breaks the established '<verb> needs <flag>' wording
findings.detail: Every sibling usage-required-flag message in this package omits the 'takt' prefix — cmd_answer.go:42 'answer needs --gate and --choice', cmd_waive.go:29 'waive needs --task N and --reason', cmd_init.go:163 'init needs a topic'. cmd_retro.go:39 instead reads 'takt retro needs --rewrite', the only one of this family to include the binary name. Purely cosmetic (the test only checks for the substring '--rewrite'), but it's a divergent shape for the same kind of message across the CLI.
